const yes: true = !!true;
const no: false = !!0;
const triple: true = !(!(!false));
const fourfold: false = !!!!false;
let mutable = !!1;
const initial: true = mutable;
mutable = false;
const changed: false = mutable;
function nonempty(value: string | undefined) {
  if (!!!value) return 'empty';
  return value.toUpperCase();
}
console.log(yes, no, triple, fourfold, initial, changed, nonempty('word'), nonempty(undefined));
